svg.title: A small canvas, stretched over the battle
svg.desc: Above, the canvas during Heat Wave: a picture 128 by 128 pixels where the effect draws its blaze. Each pixel holds a level on a ramp of 64 colours, from nothing, which is see-through, up to the brightest. Below, the screen at the same moment: the canvas is stretched to twice its width and blended over the battle, so the blaze crosses most of the screen and the battle shows through it.
svg.text: The screen: the battle shows through the blaze.
